headword: {国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}

definitions.gloss: singing of the national anthem (in unison)
definitions.explanation: Singing the national anthem together, as an item in the programme of a ceremony, a sports event, or a school assembly.

examples.japanese: {国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{起立|きりつ}→起立：32025_kiritsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stand for the singing of the national anthem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The national anthem was sung before the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}をめぐって⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧きた。
examples.english: Singing the national anthem at graduation ceremonies has been debated for many years.

notes:
⟦{国歌|こっか}→国歌：31411_kokka⟧ (national anthem) + ⟦{斉唱|せいしょう}→斉唱：31949_seishou⟧ (singing in unison). In a printed programme it appears as one item: ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辞|じ}, {国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}, …

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to sing the national anthem (as part of a ceremony)
- {国歌斉唱|こっかせいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起立|きりつ}→起立：32025_kiritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stand for the national anthem

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's anthem is {君|きみ}が{代|よ}. Whether teachers must stand and sing it at school ceremonies has been a long-running political and legal dispute.
